'''Phytosus moss''' was a type of [[Photosynthesis/Legends|photosynthetic]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. It was considered a delicacy to the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]], the indigenous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who could smell the scent a ripe colony emitted from up to half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] away. Like all Goroth mosses, phytosus moss was [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] to off-worlders due to the small concentrations of [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbarides]] absorbed by the moss from the [[Stone/Legends|rocks]] it grew on.<ref name="Goroth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phytosus moss was mentioned in the [[1995]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]'', written by [[Nigel D. Findley]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Goroth" />
